claim: The hypothesis that the Kandyan state deliberately kept approaches, forests, bridges and passes underdeveloped as a formal defence doctrine remains unresolved in Run17.
bounded_by: No Kandyan-era or colonial-era documentary anchor explicitly establishing deliberate non-development as state doctrine was secured in Run17; the claim may not exceed B until such an anchor exists.
notes: The arc's strongest idea is therefore kept as an open hypothesis, not promoted because it is narratively attractive.
